# South Yorkshire Property Buyers

> A residential property-buying service offering an individually assessed direct-sale option. This is a curated map of public information, not a substitute for a written offer or legal advice.

South Yorkshire Property Buyers is a trading name used by Bullseye Properties Ltd (company number 14869608), which handles seller-facing enquiries, offers and paperwork, in partnership with a purchasing company. See the [company and purchasing details](https://southyorkshirepropertybuyers.com/about/#company-details) for the entities involved.

An offer may be below the price achievable on the open market. Price, costs, conditions and timing depend on the property and the current written terms. Legal checks and authority to sell still matter; accepting an ordinary offer is not a guarantee of completion.

## Main seller journeys
- [Probate property](https://southyorkshirepropertybuyers.com/sell-house-during-probate/): Discuss the home, authority to act and probate stage.
- [Urgent sale](https://southyorkshirepropertybuyers.com/need-to-sell-house-urgently/): Discuss a real deadline and whether a direct purchase could fit.
- [Sale fallen through](https://southyorkshirepropertybuyers.com/sell-house-chain-fell-through/): Explore another option after a failed sale, subject to the existing legal position.
- [Poor-condition property](https://southyorkshirepropertybuyers.com/selling-house-poor-condition-options/): Consider a sale without first taking on a renovation.
- [Modern auction not sold](https://southyorkshirepropertybuyers.com/house-not-sold-modern-auction/): Compare a direct offer after checking continuing auction obligations.
